basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Sacramento, I'm a 28-year-old sound engineer with a passion for synthesizers and music production. I spend most of my days working on audio projects and exploring new ways to create unique soundscapes. Despite my love for technology, I'm not particularly invested in politics or current affairs, which is why my interest in the Pandora Papers is more about the intrigue than the implications. In my free time, I enjoy playing Rust, where I often team up with friends for long-term strategy and raids. I usually log on to Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8 PM PST. I'm currently single, enjoying the freedom to dive deep into my hobbies without distractions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been working in the audio engineering field for over 7 years, with a focus on synthesizers and digital sound design. My expertise is largely self-taught, supplemented by online courses and forums. I also have a LEED certification, showcasing my interest in sustainable building and design.
